packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-12 - unverified image reading (first reader)
No identification or prior reading of this packet was present in my context.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-only)
Packet holds 8 overviews (image-001, -004, -011, -018, -023, -028, -033, -038), each followed by native-resolution tiles.

image-001 (overview): four paper pieces on black ground with ruler and colour chart; grey redaction boxes (modern masks) over parts of the images.
- Top: a bifolium-like piece (pencil labels "Stams, STA, Frg. 110_1a" lower left and "Stams, STA, Frg. 110_2a" lower right), opened flat, with a transparent strip/tape along the centre fold; a tall grey mask covers the centre. Text is a German document hand (Kurrent/Kanzlei cursive) in brown ink, running continuously across the opening, about 15 long lines. A large flourished calligraphic initial (looks like "I"/"J" with cadels) at upper left begins the text; flourished ascenders in the top line. Not columnar; single block of prose (a letter/charter-type document?, tentative). Green stains near the foot of the right half.
- Bottom left: piece labelled "Stams, STA, Frg. 110_3a", sparse entries in a different (looser) hand: "m. 26", names and sums, "m. 30 ... Dito"; looks like a register/account-type layout (tentative). Grey mask at lower left.
- Bottom right: piece labelled "Stams, STA, Frg. 110_4a", torn left edge, faint flourished entries ("2 ... ", "m. 2..").
Orientation: upright.

image-002 (tile: the top opened piece, Frg. 110_1a + 110_2a; text area also viewed in crop-01.jpg, a native-resolution crop of image-002)
Hand: German cursive document hand (Kurrent), brown ink, single text block of ~15 lines running across the fold; large cadel initial at upper left; flourished ascenders in line 1 and top margin. A grey mask covers the centre of every line (about 1/4 of the line width) so each line is read in a left segment and a right segment. Lines slope; pairing of left and right segments across the mask is by position and is uncertain by +/- one line. Lines numbered from the top of the text block on image-002.
LEFT of mask (line openings):
002/1  Ich Jacob [mask]
002/2  vnr(?) d[...] [mask]
002/3  zu hann[...] [mask]
002/4  Zwelff(?) [...] [mask]
002/5  Ainn(?) [...] [mask]
002/6  Disen dre[...] [mask]
002/7  Ist(?) z(?) w[...] [mask]
002/8  Zwelft(?) g[...] [mask]
002/9  Zuhenng(?)[...] [mask]
002/10 Dreffig(?) [...] [mask]
002/11 fryn(?) bitt[...] [mask]
002/12 vndrinz(?) [...] [mask]
002/13 Elsp(?) vn[...] [mask]
002/14 vnn(?) vnnd(?) [...] [mask]
002/15 der beichl(?) [...] [mask]
RIGHT of mask (line continuations, same order):
002/1  [mask] ...erg kennesch(?) bys(?) ojz(?) zengwarten(?) Ikem(?)
002/2  [mask] ...t hanns hemerl(?) drenstorffer(?) hausmey(?)
002/3  [mask] ...ch ersprecht(?) vnnd behalt(?) hat benamtl(ich)(?)
002/4  [mask] ...nsch(?) [ink blot] vnn(?) an dem funffte(?) tag Ma[...]
002/5  [mask] ...lfft(?) dz(?) funffte(?) tag benelts(?) Zwain[...](?)
002/6  [mask] ...ungen(?) bestelt(?) briefs(?) von obgemelter(?) Ver[...]
002/7  [mask] ...dergenedigisten(?) Herren(?) erstellg(?) der[...]
002/8  [mask] ...ft(?) meins dienstpells(?) Ochsen(?) den zu[...]
002/9  [mask] ...urre(?) deshalben(?) kain(?) vom(?) gentlicnd(?) [...]
002/10 [mask] ...g vnnd des(?) zu vrkundt(?) von meyner(?) [...]
002/11 [mask] ...siegelt(?) mit des Edlen Oeningen(?) [...]
002/12 [mask] ...hiestrumst(?) peter(?) Ortgalt(?) dem(?) [...]
002/13 [mask] ...gen(?) herrschen(?) furgetrewktend(?) briefschaf[...](?)
002/14 [mask] ...en(?) an schaden(?) vnnd ader(?) ist(?) Ohnatz(?)[...]
002/15 [mask] ...[illegible] hilf(?) vnnd dem(?) [illegible] Datum(?)
Limitations: the hand is fast and heavily looped; many readings are letter-shape guesses. Right edge also has grey masks over lines 6-8 and below line 15. Left part of the left leaf (cadel initial area) carries no text. Line ends at right margin are cut by the page edge.

image-003 (tile: lower two pieces of overview 001; top strip of image-003 overlaps the foot of the upper piece, no text there)
Hand: a later-looking, looser cursive with large looped capitals; few lines, widely spaced; right edge of 110_3a and left edge of 110_4a are cut/torn so entries are truncated. Layout of dated entries ("m." + number + abbreviation sign + month/"Dito") suggests an account or register (tentative).
Left piece (Frg. 110_3a), lines from top of piece:
003/L1  [flourish] m 26 [abbrev. sign, like "L"/"d."] Sept(?)[...]   (the "Sept/Dep..." word is cut at the right edge)
003/L2  Hanns(?) Lendgreb(?) be[...](?)   (cut)
003/L3  4 ß(?) Bawm(?) vnnd(?) 5 ß(?)[...]   (cut)
003/L4  m 30 [same abbrev. sign] Dito
003/L5  Peter(?) Fernachs(?) fern(?)[...]   (cut; a ruled line drawn beneath)
Lower left of piece under grey mask.
Right piece (Frg. 110_4a), lines from top:
003/R1  [struck-through or flourished word at top right, illegible]
003/R2  [large looped initial] 2 ß(?) Jahr(?)/Ahr(?)[...]   (cut)
003/R3  Hanns(?) Lr(?)[...]   (faint, cut)
003/R4  [looped initial] m 2[...]   (cut)
003/R5  [looped initial] ...an Bur(?)/Ber(?)[...]  (faint)
003/R6  ...b(?)[...]   (faint)
003/R7  [faint] .1. 2(?)[...]
003/R8  [faint] 3 ... [...]
Limitations: ink very faint on 110_4a; most of its entries only partially visible because the left edge is torn and the right edge cuts the lines.

image-004 (overview 2): large grey mask over upper left (a sheet/backing). The top piece is shown in a different state, folded at an angle and held flat by glass weights; pencil labels "Stams, STA, Frg. 110_1v" (rotated) and "Stams, STA, Frg. 110_2v"(?) (rotated) visible, so this appears to be the reverse of the upper piece. Its surface shows mostly staining with almost no visible text at overview scale; a word near the glass weight (rotated, "...ozo"/"Dolo"? possibly a dorsal note). Lower two pieces appear identical to those on image-001 (labels 110_3a, 110_4a) - same faces re-photographed (observation).

image-005 (tile, upper left of overview 004): grey mask, glass weight, modern backing paper and corners of the reverse pieces; no text visible.

image-006 (tile, upper right of overview 004): reverse of upper-right piece (rotated ~30 deg). Stained, blotchy surface; no ink text visible. Faint vertical ghost bands (offset/impression?) only. Small red-ink pencil-like mark on the modern backing paper (modern). No text.

image-007 (tile, middle left of overview 004): reverse of the left half of the upper piece, rotated ~45 deg, grey mask over its centre; stained, no ink text visible outside mask.
